text:
maria: FYI customer AcmeAnalytics reported multiple service accounts removed after last night's KMS rotate. They noticed missing RBAC bindings and failing scheduled jobs.

devon: saw the alert. Wasn't that the alias flip we performed at 02:00 UTC? :grimacing: 

maria: Yes. They claim SCIM webhook responses were 200s but the provisioner ledger shows no entries for those users. Audit logs from the provisioner are thin.

alex: Quick triage notes: 1) Alias swap completed ~02:04. 2) Provisioner returned 202 on deprovision calls. 3) downstream services show decrypt errors when resolving ext_id.

security-oncall: Paste the provisioner error please.

alex: Here you go: 
```
2026-03-22T02:07:10Z provisioner ERROR decrypt ext_id failed: kms.Decrypt: InvalidCiphertextException: CMK not found for keyId arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1111-aaaa-2222-bbbb
```

devon: That looks like clients presented ciphertext wrapped with the old CMK ARN but the alias now references a different CMK. Could also be an envelope format change (we moved from local AES wrap to KMS JWE).

maria: Oddly it's partial: some tenants unaffected. My guess is the rewrap migration didn't finish for all tenants — possibly hit KMS throttling.

security-oncall: InvalidCiphertext implies decrypt failed -> provisioner can't read ext_id -> treats identity as unknown -> issues deprovision. Need to confirm whether ext_id blobs were rewrapped at rotate time.

alex: Pulled sample blobs: two formats present. e.g. 
```
old: ENC:AESGCM:v1|payload...
new: ENC:KMSJWE:v2|payload...
```

devon: The migration runner was supposed to rewrap every ext_id pre-flip. Logs show it completed ~60% before hitting rate limits and backing off. That maps to the partial impact.

maria: Customer impact: several scheduled workers failed with 403, SRE opened a P1. We should escalate to #incidents and loop in account team.

security-oncall: Proposed immediate steps: 1) Disable auto-deprovision globally (or per-tenant) to stop further churn. 2) Re-run targeted rewrap backfill for affected tenant(s). 3) Generate audit backfill entries for any missing actions for compliance. 4) Postmortem/vuln triage on migration design and rate-limiting behavior.

alex: Pushed a temporary flag to stop auto deprovision: 
PATCH /config/flags {"scim.auto_deprovision": false} -> 200 OK

devon: I'll run the rewrap job in controlled batches with smaller batch size and exponential backoff for KMS 429s. I'll route the calls through the rate-limiter service. First pass ETA ~1h.

maria: Add verbose per-ext_id logging so we have clear audit lines showing rewrap success/failure for compliance.

security-oncall: Also open a cloud infra ticket to confirm KMS alias propagation guarantees. If some services cached the canonical key ARN, that could explain intermittent InvalidCiphertext. Ticket CLOUDF-9876 created.

alex: Attached a sample set of 8 affected ciphertexts and request traces to CLOUDF-9876 for their forensics.

devon: Rewrap job kicked off. Rolling 5 tenants at a time, retry/backoff on 429. Streaming progress here.

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] Rewrap job v2.1 started by devon in namespace scim-backfill. JobID: rb-20260322-42.

maria: Reminder: RBAC changes are risky. Do not re-enable auto-deprov until we confirm decrypt success for that tenant. Good call on the flag.

security-oncall: For the postmortem include timeline, root cause (partial rewrap due to KMS throttling), mitigation (kill-switch + rewrap), and longer-term fixes (atomic rewrap strategy pre-flip, preflight completeness checks, and audit lag monitoring).

alex: Forensics note: the provisioner only emitted audit entries after successful decrypt. We'll add a "decrypt-failed" audit event so we have a trail even on failures.

devon: Rewrap pass 1 ~60% done; observed transient 429s, retried successfully. Added jitter and slower ramp.

maria: After pass 2, coordinate with account team before re-enabling deprovision for that tenant.

devon: Will produce CSV of user_id -> rewrap_status for ACME.

security-oncall: Security question: should we move to per-tenant CMKs to reduce blast radius? Add to vuln triage doc and include cost/ops impact.

maria: +1 on that action.

sre-bot: [alert] ACME reported jobs started succeeding after partial rewrap. Ticket ACME-334 updated.

alex: Drafting incident update with artifacts for #incidents and customer channel. Closing this thread unless other issues surface.

maria: thanks all.
